# Java Edition protocol/Object data

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.8.9`  
> Protocol version: `47`  
> Source: [Java Edition protocol/Object data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Object_data?oldid=2767851)  
> Revision: `2767851` (`2016-01-11T01:09:10Z`)  
> Retrieved: `2026-08-04T16:00:27+00:00`  
> License: [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)

This article documents the **Data** field in the [Spawn Object](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol#Spawn_Object "Protocol") packet. The field is of type Int, and the meaning of its contents depend on the [type of object](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Entities#Objects "Entities") being spawned, as defined in the Type field of the same packet, and is documented below.

## Contents

- [1 Minecarts (id 10)](https://minecraft.wiki#Minecarts_(id_10))
- [2 Item Frame (id 71)](https://minecraft.wiki#Item_Frame_(id_71))
- [3 Falling Block (id 70)](https://minecraft.wiki#Falling_Block_(id_70))
- [4 Splash Potions (id 73)](https://minecraft.wiki#Splash_Potions_(id_73))
- [5 Fishing Float (id 90)](https://minecraft.wiki#Fishing_Float_(id_90))
- [6 Projectiles (Any projectile)](https://minecraft.wiki#Projectiles_(Any_projectile))

## Minecarts (id 10)

The int value itself specifies the minecart's functionality:

| Value | Minecart functionality |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Empty (ride-able) minecart |
| 1 | Chest minecart |
| 2 | Furnace (powered) minecart |
| 3 | TNT minecart |
| 4 | Spawner minecart |
| 5 | Hopper minecart |
| 6 | Command Block minecart |

## Item Frame (id 71)

| Value | Orientation |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | South |
| 1 | West |
| 2 | North |
| 3 | East |

## Projectiles ([Any projectile](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Entities#Objects "Entities"))

This includes ghast fireballs, arrows, and fishhooks (probably more).
